To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present an event based unsupervised online learning architecture with spike based deep neural networks which is fully timescale invariant and does not require any external supervision.

we have designed a fully event driven spiking deep convolutional network which performs unsupered online learning and inference with spike timing dependent synaptic plasticity from a stream of continuous event based data, and that it is possible without providing implicit information such as the number or the duration of classes and stimuli.
we introduce a deep learning architecture which is able to learn hierarchical features from a stream of event based data in a timescale invariant way.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a deep spiking neural network architecture which can learn from a continuous and event based stream of sensory input.
the development of a neuromorphic system for unsupervised online learning from event based data, which can perform inference during training.
the development of a novel deep spiking convolution neural network which is able to perform online learning from event based sensor data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed architecture can be used for online unsupervised learning of hierarchical features from event based data and that it is event driven, timescale invariant and requires no explicit knowledge about the database.

the network can be trained in a fully unsupervised way without any prior knowledge about the data and that it is capable of online learning and inference on continuous data streams with event based sensors.
our architecture allows for unsupervised online learning from a continuous event based input stream, without providing any information about the database and with a fully event driven dynamics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a novel deep learning architecture for neuromorphic hardware which can be trained from an event based sensor and which performs inference in a time scale invariant way.

we have designed an event based deep spiking convolution neural network which performs online unsupervised deep feature learning with STDP from asynchronous event streams and which can be trained with only relative timing information.
we have developed the first event based, timescale invariant, unsupervised online learning deep spiking neural network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible for an unsupervised deep network with STDP to learn hierarchical features and to perform inference from a stream of event based data without any prior knowledge about the data.
a deep learning architecture based on STDP can be trained in a fully online manner, without requiring a timescale for its dynamics, which makes it suitable for event based neuromorphic systems.
it is possible and efficient to train deep networks with spikes in an online fashion, without the need for a database framework.
